safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the absence of unwell contacts removes a minor piece of epidemiologic context but does not materially change the assessment or immediate management in this uncomplicated viral-URI style presentation, especially since key symptoms (SOB, feverishness) are otherwise captured. This is unlikely to lead to a different clinical decision on its own.
